reproduction.platform: macOS with Swift and Apple AVFoundation/CoreImage frameworks
reproduction.posters: The exporter writes complete selected source frames as PNG into FRAME_DIR, using posterSourceSeconds when set and otherwise the selected clip start. Convert those three images to WebP quality 86 without resizing or cropping; film and poster provenance is in manifest.json.
reproduction.timing: The intended 24.4-second timeline is rounded up to 586 complete frames at 24 fps (24.4166667 seconds). Original source audio is omitted. No case captions are baked into the movie.
